messages:
Sam K.: Noticed a pileup in new leads stuck at 'enrichment-pending' around 13:14 PDT. HubSpot webhooks are coming in but owner assignment not completing. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/leadflow/slow-handoff
ops-bot: Alert: inbound_handoff_median > 180s for 350 leads (threshold 120s)
Priya R.: I see the same in monitoring. Enrichment service shows brief spike in 502s at 13:13-13:16. RR worker logs show 'waiting for enrichment' for many IDs.
Ben T.: Quick summary: our current flow waits for enrichment before round-robin. If enrichment callback fails we mark as HOLD and skip assignment. That reduces bad assignments but causes delays when enrichment is flaky.
Vera L.: Could we try a short experiment: set enrichment.fallback=yield_for_any and enrichment.yield_ttl=20m for new leads. That would let RR assign immediately and let enrichment be retried async. We should scope to marketing channel only for safety.
Priya R.: +1 to scoped experiment. We'll need to add a small telemetry tag so we can measure quality drops (e.g., enrichment-missing -> % of owners with missing enrichment within 1h).
Ben T.: I'll prepare a canary rollout: 10% of marketing leads (by routing tag) for 30m. Rollback key: revert flag enrichment.yield_for_marketing.
ops-bot: Deployment event: feature-flag enrichment-yield-marketing enabled (canary 10%).
Sam K.: Please also add a CS notification if a lead is VIP and enrichment missing after 10m so they can follow up manually.
CS-Alerts: Note: we only want CS pings for leads with company_size>50 or lead_score>85. I'll wire the filters.
Ben T.: Canary running. Initial results: median handoff latency dropped from 210s -> 25s for affected subset. Enrichment-complete within 1h for ~82% (baseline 93%). So some degradation in enrichment-complete rate, but owners get assigned faster.
Priya R.: Can we get a sample of mis-enriched leads to check if anything critical is missing for assignment? If not, I think yield is a net positive for marketing ops.
Vera L.: Pulling 50 random leads where enrichment didn't complete within 1h. Quick scan: 38/50 only missing optional fields (company_website, employee_count). 12/50 missing email or company domain which affects routing.
Sam K.: That's the tradeoff. Proposal: keep yield but add an enrichment-priority requeue for leads missing routing-critical fields. Also add a pre-assignment check: if routing-critical fields missing, assign to 'manual-review' instead of RR. That keeps RR efficient while protecting routing quality.
Ben T.: Implemented feature toggle: enrichment.critical_fields=[email,company_domain]; if missing -> manual-review queue. Canary updated to 15%.
ops-bot: Metric update: marketing canary 15% - handoff median 18s; enrichment-critical-missing routed to manual-review (approx 9% of canary leads).
Priya R.: OK let's run full 100% rollout in 1 hour if metrics stay stable. Action items: Ben - roll to 100% and add dashboard tile for critical-missing %, Vera - add post-run sample to INC-3450, Sam - notify marketing ops and CS playbook owners.
Ben T.: Will roll to 100% at +60m if no regression. Rolling out incremental steps.
Sam K.: Thanks team. Filing a short doc with rationale & runbook in /docs/marketing/lead-handoff-yield-experiment.md :memo:
CS-Alerts: CS notified about process change and manual-review queue created.
